system_description.narrative_title: Middle East escalation drives oil volatility and regional security shifts
system_description.narrative_summary: A surge in Houthi attacks, Iranian backing and Israeli-Iran tensions is creating a self-reinforcing cycle of military escalation, diplomatic maneuvering and disruption to oil flows that is rippling through global markets and regional politics. As an open system, interstate and proxy actions (attacks, intelligence, strike plans) interact with economic feedbacks (oil prices, SPR releases, investor decisions) and international responses (military deployments, conference postponements, mediation), producing fast-moving, cross-border effects. Short-term shocks (airport strikes, ship attacks) feed market volatility and political signaling, which in turn alter incentives for further military or diplomatic steps — heightening systemic sensitivity and contagion risk across the region and global energy supply chains.
system_description.scope: Actors, processes and assets directly involved in the current escalation: Houthi forces, Iran (hardliners and state actors), Saudi Arabian security and infrastructure, Gulf states' responses, Israel–Iran tensions, Egypt/Turkey/Qatar/Pakistan diplomatic and military moves, commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, global oil markets (prices, inventories, refiners), international military deployments and major regional events (e.g., Davos in the Desert).
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-security and energy system (international diplomacy, global markets, and strategic military balances)
adjacent_subsystems: Israel domestic politics and the Iran policy debate (elections, leadership choices)
Global oil markets and energy supply chains (trading, inventories, refiners)
Maritime security and shipping through choke points (Strait of Hormuz, Gulf transits)
Great-power diplomacy and military support (US/UK/EU regional commitments)
evidence_headlines: Oil hits five-month high of $110 on new escalation in Middle East
Saudi Arabia postpones 'Davos in the Desert' conference after Houthi attacks
Houthi attack kills 53 at Yemen government training camp, officials say
Iran Is Giving Houthis Targeting and Intelligence for Attacks on Saudi Arabia
UK to deploy jets to defend Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks
Israel pushes to restart strikes against Iran

variables.name: Military engagement intensity
variables.description: The aggregate intensity and scale of kinetic military operations and direct confrontations across the region.

variables.name: Proxy attack frequency
variables.description: The rate at which irregular or proxy forces carry out attacks, strikes, or offensive incidents over time.

variables.name: Maritime transit security risk
variables.description: The prevailing level of risk to commercial shipping and transit through key maritime choke points due to hostile actions or threats.

variables.name: Oil supply disruption level
variables.description: The degree to which physical crude and refined product supply chains are interrupted, delayed, or removed from markets.

variables.name: Global oil price level
variables.description: The representative market price level for crude oil and major benchmarks that reflects supply-demand and risk premia.

variables.name: Strategic reserve volume
variables.description: The aggregated volume of emergency petroleum inventories held for crisis response and market stabilization.

variables.name: Market volatility index
variables.description: The magnitude of short-term price and trading volatility in energy and related financial markets.

variables.name: Investor risk aversion
variables.description: The prevailing degree of risk aversion among energy and financial market participants influencing capital flows and hedging.

variables.name: Diplomatic engagement intensity
variables.description: The frequency, scale, and vigor of diplomatic communications, negotiations, and mediation efforts among actors.

variables.name: Intelligence sharing level
variables.description: The extent and timeliness of operational intelligence exchange and coordination among security actors.

variables.name: Regional political cohesion
variables.description: The overall alignment and cooperative coherence of political actors in the region when responding to security and economic shocks.

variables.name: Military deployment scale
variables.description: The total scale and distribution of deployed military forces and assets positioned in or near the region.

variables.name: Commercial shipping throughput
variables.description: The volume rate of commercial cargo and energy shipments transiting key maritime routes and ports.

variables.name: Energy infrastructure capacity
variables.description: The operational capacity of refineries, pipelines, terminals, and other energy infrastructure to process and move fuels.

variables.name: Domestic political pressure level
variables.description: The intensity of internal political pressures on policymakers from electorates, interest groups, and public opinion related to security and energy policy.

variables.name: Mediation and resolution capacity
variables.description: The available institutional and procedural capacity to broker de-escalation, manage disputes, and achieve negotiated settlements.

catalysts.title: Israeli election result and coalition shift
catalysts.description: Imminent Israeli election could alter leadership or hardline influence, affecting decisions on strikes and regional policy.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Trump endorses Netanyahu'; 'Israel's election may change its leader, but not Iran war policy'; 'Ben-Gvir poised for election gains'.

catalysts.title: Israel pushes to resume strikes against Iran
catalysts.description: A renewed Israeli kinetic campaign against Iran or Iranian assets would sharply escalate regional conflict and risk premiums.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Israel pushes to restart strikes against Iran'; 'Netanyahu made plans to restart Iran strikes earlier this month.'

catalysts.title: Continued Houthi attacks and escalation
catalysts.description: Ongoing Houthi strikes on Saudi targets and shipping are likely to continue, sustaining regional insecurity and market risk premia.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Houthi attack kills 58/73'; 'Houthis encircle new target'; 'Houthis escalate attacks on kingdom.'

catalysts.title: Western defensive air missions over Saudi Arabia
catalysts.description: UK (and potentially allied) fighter deployments and defensive air missions to protect Saudi targets will change force posture and coordination.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'UK to deploy jets to defend Saudi Arabia'; 'Britain says it will carry out defensive air missions over Saudi Arabia.'

catalysts.title: Turkey parliamentary mandate to send troops to Saudi Arabia
catalysts.description: Turkish parliamentary approval to deploy personnel to Saudi Arabia would expand external deployments and shift regional alignments.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Turkey plans mandate to send military personnel to Saudi Arabia'; 'Turkey, Qatar, Pakistan, Indonesia sign defence cooperation accord.'

catalysts.title: Intensive diplomatic shuttle and mediation efforts
catalysts.description: Accelerated diplomacy to head off wider escalation — high-level visits, offers and talks — will shape de-escalation prospects.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Diplomats Race to Head Off Escalation With Iran'; 'Iran FM: We are ready for diplomacy.'

catalysts.title: U.S. strategic reserve policy decision (possible release)
catalysts.description: Low U.S. SPR levels could trigger policy action (sales/releases or replenishment decisions) affecting market supply and prices.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Oil stocks in US strategic petroleum reserve fall to lowest level since 1982'; 'U.S. Crude Oil Stockpiles Fall More Than Expected.'

catalysts.title: Further attacks on vessels in Strait of Hormuz
catalysts.description: Renewed strikes/sabotage in the Strait of Hormuz could disrupt shipping throughput and raise oil market risk premia.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Two Cargo Ships Sink Near Strait of Hormuz'; 'Oil Rises Amid Attacks on Vessels in Strait of Hormuz.'

catalysts.title: Indian refiners trim Middle East oil imports
catalysts.description: Planned adjustments by Indian Oil and refiners to reduce Middle East imports under annual deals will shift regional flows and volumes.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Indian Oil to trim Middle East oil imports under annual deals amid Iran war.'

catalysts.title: Investor withdrawals and boycott of Saudi conference
catalysts.description: Continued withdrawals and reputational concerns around Saudi investor events will sustain risk aversion and dampen regional investment flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Saudi Arabia postpones big investor conference to 2027'; 'Wall Street Leaders Are Weighing Bailing on ‘Davos in the Desert’.'
